name: Page Info Panel
description: Shows a floating panel with useful page info: title, URL, links count, images count, video sources

params.code:
var old = document.getElementById('cp-page-info'); if (old) old.remove(); var d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = 'cp-page-info'; d.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:20px;right:20px;width:400px;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;background:#161b22;border:2px solid #30363d;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;z-index:99999;color:#c9d1d9;font-family:monospace;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);'; d.innerHTML = '
Page Info✕
'; d.innerHTML += '
Title: ' + document.title + '
'; d.innerHTML += '
URL: ' + location.href + '
'; d.innerHTML += '
Links: ' + document.querySelectorAll('a').length + ' | Images: ' + document.querySelectorAll('img').length + ' | Videos: ' + document.querySelectorAll('video').length + ' | Iframes: ' + document.querySelectorAll('iframe').length + '
'; var vids = document.querySelectorAll('video'); if (vids.length > 0) { d.innerHTML += '
Video Sources:
'; vids.forEach(function(v,i) { d.innerHTML += '
' + (i+1) + '. ' + (v.src || v.currentSrc || '(blob/no src)') + '
'; }); } document.body.appendChild(d); return 'shown';
